sentences.text:
1. The claimants have challenged the judgment and award dated 22.2.2018 passed by the MACT NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2230/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined (Main),
Dahod in MACP no.256/07 for enhancement of the compensation amount mainly on the ground that the income has not been assessed as per the work of the deceased and consortium amount has not been granted to all the claimants.

2. Mr. Hakim submitted that the deceased was doing centring work and also was carrying on the agriculture activities and the learned Tribunal in absence of any cogent evidence could have relied upon the money wages schedule on the date of the accident and thus, could have granted just compensation.

It is further submitted that the consortium amount has not been granted as per the decision in the case of Magma General Insurance Company Limited Vs. Nanu Ram alias Chuhru Ram & Ors., reported in (2018) 18 SCC 130.
3.

entities.text: Magma General Insurance Company Limited Vs. Nanu Ram alias Chuhru Ram & Ors., reported in (2018) 18 SCC 130
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Mrs. Pathak submitted that since no evidence was led to show that the deceased was NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2230/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined undertaking centring work and was doing agriculture activities, the amount so granted is just and reasonable.
4.

The vehicular accident took place on 20.1.2007 while the deceased Govindbhai Bhavsingbhai Damor was traveling in the jeep of opponent no.4 bearing registration no. GJ-20 A-293 and was going for his social work towards village Timarda and while returning back at about 5.30 at Village Kathla, Nr. Kalis Riverpool, opponent no.1 came with his jeep bearing registration no. GJ-20 A-266 came in an excessive speed and in a rash and negligent manner and driving on the wrong side dashed the jeep of opponent no.4.
The deceased who was sitting behind the driver was thrown down on the road and the wheels of the jeep ran over him and thus, was pressed down below the wheels.

5. The learned Tribunal while assessing NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2230/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined negligence aspect has held the driver of driver of jeep bearing registration no. GJ-20 A-266 solely negligent for the accident and therefore, made opponent no.6-insurance Company liable to pay the amount.

6. At the time of the accident, the deceased was aged about 28 years and thus, in accordance to the judgment in the case of Sarla Verma Vs. Delhi Transport Corporation & Anr., (2009) 6 SCC 121, he would fall within the age group of 26-30 and accordingly, multiplier of 17 was applied by the learned Tribunal.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The learned Tribunal has further considered 40% rise in prospective income which is in accordance to the judgment in the case of National Insurance Company Limited Vs. Pranay Sethi &

sentences.text: However, the monthly income assessed was Rs.1,728/- for the accident which took place on 20.1.2007 is on the lower side.

The material supplied to this Court shows the minimum wages for the skilled NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2230/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined labour in Zone-B and semi skilled labour as Rs.2,500/- and thus,
on that minimum wages, 40% prospective rise is to be considered.
Hence, the claimants would be entitled for dependency loss.

Rs.2,500/- + 40% = Rs.3,500/-
- 1/4 personal expenses.
Hence, monthly dependency would be Rs.2,625/-.
Considering it annually

,
applying the multiplier of 17, total dependency loss is Rs.5,35,500/-.
The learned Tribunal has considered the amount under the head of loss to estate and funeral expenses as per the decision in the case of Pranay Sethi (supra).
7. In the case of Magma General Insurance Company Limited (supra), it has been held as under:-
"8.7 A Constitution Bench of this Court in Pranay Sethi (supra) dealt with the various heads under which compensation is to be awarded in a death case.
One of these heads is Loss of Consortium.

In legal parlance, "consortium" is a compendious term which encompasses 'spousal consortium',
'parental NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2230/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined consortium', and 'filial consortium'.
The right to consortium would include the company, care, help, comfort, guidance, solace and affection of the deceased, which is a loss to his family.
With respect to a spouse, it would include sexual relations with the deceased spouse.
(Rajesh and Ors. vs. Rajbir Singh and Ors. (2013) 9 SCC 54)

entities.text: Rajesh and Ors. vs. Rajbir Singh and Ors. (2013) 9 SCC 54
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Spousal consortium is generally defined as rights pertaining to the relationship of a husband-wife which allows compensation to the surviving spouse for loss of "company, society, co- operation, affection, and aid of the other in every conjugal relation."
BLACK'S LAW DICTIONARY (5th ed. 1979)

Parental consortium is granted to the child upon the premature death of a parent, for loss of "parental aid, protection, affection, society,
discipline, guidance and training."
Filial consortium is the right of the parents to compensation in the case of an accidental death of a child.
An accident leading to the death of a child causes great shock and agony to the parents and family of the deceased.
The greatest agony for a parent is to lose their child during their lifetime.
Children are valued for their love, affection, companionship and their role in the family unit.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2230/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined
Consortium is a special prism reflecting changing norms about the status and worth of actual relationships.
Modern jurisdictions world-over have recognized that the value of a child's consortium far exceeds the economic value of the compensation awarded in the case of the death of a child.
Most jurisdictions therefore permit parents to be awarded compensation under loss of consortium on the death of a child.

The amount awarded to the parents is a compensation for loss of the love, affection,
care and companionship of the deceased child.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Motor Vehicles Act is a beneficial legislation aimed at providing relief to the victims or their families, in cases of genuine claims.
In case where a parent has lost their minor child, or unmarried son or daughter, the parents are entitled to be awarded loss of consortium under the head of Filial Consortium.
Parental Consortium is awarded to children who lose their parents in motor vehicle accidents under the Act."
8. In this case, the claimants are the widow, 3 minors and father of the deceased.

Hence, as per decision in the case of Magma General Insurance Company Limited (supra), each NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2230/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined claimant would be entitled to Rs.40,000/- and therefore, under the said head, compensation of Rs.2,00,000/- is granted.

Thus, the computation is as under:-
Rs.5,35,500/- Dependency loss Rs.15,000/- Loss to estate Rs.15,000/-
Funeral expenses Rs.2,00,000/- Consortium amount Rs.7,65,500/- Total compensation 9.

As the Tribunal has granted compensation of Rs.4,80,056/- with interest at the rate of 9% per annum, the appellants - claimants would be entitled to the enhanced amount of compensation of Rs.2,85,444/- with interest at the rate of 7.5% per annum from the date of filing of the claim petition till its realization.
The insurance Company is directed to deposit the said amount within eight weeks from the date of receipt of writ of this Court.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2230/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined 10.
The impugned judgment and award be modified accordingly.
The appeal is partly allowed.
Registry is directed to send the record and proceedings back to the Tribunal, if received.
(GITA GOPI,J) Maulik Shanuben Govindbhai Damor vs Pritamsinh Jagatsinh Bakliya on 18 July, 2023
